title: Lea Salonga to lead 'Ang Tahanan ni Bernarda Alba' in February 2027
summary: Broadway star Lea Salonga is set to take on the lead role in Theatre Group Asia's (TGA) upcoming production of 'Ang Tahanan ni Bernarda Alba,' scheduled to premiere in February 2027.
